resolverContract.meaning: The full lowercase SHA resolves to this commit.
The repository is readable but the candidate is not an available commit.

headRules: Both heads must be full lowercase 40-hex commit SHAs.
Both heads must resolve to the exact commit named by the field.
The derivation and review commits must be distinct.

gateOutcomes.invalid: Record or approval semantics fail, including malformed, unresolved, aliased, or equal heads.
gateOutcomes.unverifiable: No semantic failure was found, but commit resolution is unavailable.
gateOutcomes.approvedOrRejected: Semantic outcome is returned only after both commits are verified.

implemented.promotionBoundary: The resolver passes through closeout and promotion construction; an unverifiable approval projects zero promoted cells and cannot publish the approved 28-cell supersession.

inRepositoryPromotionCheck.message: Verified Sprint 182 independent-review projection: 28 foundation-v1 cells (approved).

nonGitPromotionCheck.message: Only the approved 28-cell projection can be published as the promotion supersession (approval outcome: unverifiable)

knownLimitations: A readable Git object database is required for approval. A non-Git runtime intentionally returns the named unverifiable outcome and cannot publish the promotion supersession.
Principal folding is deliberately bounded to a reviewed Cyrillic lookalike table; it is not a general-purpose Unicode identifier security algorithm.
